goal: Reconstruct and validate a known save load from the title to the expected scene.

tasks.goal: Map the title-to-save-load selection, read and return path against the pinned original, including concrete candidate slices and unresolved indirect calls.
acceptance: Identify callers, branches, state and memory effects with addresses and delimit a testable slice; distinguish observations from hypotheses.
validation_plan: Cross-check relevant disassembly and caller paths against the pinned original.

tasks.goal: Identify a reproducible isolated populated save fixture and observable scene/state for the H3 comparison without modifying original inputs.
acceptance: Record fixture provenance and identity, isolation method, expected scene and fields, or precise missing evidence.
validation_plan: Inspect the staged save and paired runtime evidence without modifying the source file.

tasks.goal: Independently review the 0x0030A9A4 candidate and its offline differential for contract, ABI, boundaries, negative control, and unsupported claims.
acceptance: Independently inspect pinned instructions and run/report provenance; identify counterexamples or recommend bounded continuation without implying milestone completion.
validation_plan: Review differential output and candidate disassembly; do not edit candidate or launch emulator.

tasks.goal: Build an offline caller-composition check for title state 7 invoking the reconstructed H3 entry and advancing to state 8, reusing established H1 harnesses where applicable.
acceptance: Exercise the actual state-7 caller path against original and candidate with explicit dependency stubs and compare state, manager/work memory, call sequence and return/fault behavior.
Include a negative control proving the caller assertion detects a wrong target or wrong next state.
validation_plan: Review existing H1 caller harness and map only the required state-7 transition; run ARM/Thumb interworking checks before any emulator use.

tasks.goal: Independently review and rerun the H3 title state-7 caller-composition evidence, including branch injection, memory assertions, gates, negative control and interworking.
acceptance: Fresh independent review and rerun with accurate evidence levels and limitations.
validation_plan: Do not edit candidate or runner, do not run emulator.

tasks.goal: Find an evidence-backed placement and patch route for the 120-byte H3 title-entry candidate alongside the integrated H1/H2 image, without changing production files.
acceptance: Report candidate size/relocations, available safe cave space in the correct composed image, branch range/mode, and exact required integrity checks.
validation_plan: Read-only inspection and local image metadata only; do not edit sources or execute emulator.

tasks.goal: Independently review the direct-call 120-byte candidate, relocation helper, H3 IPS composition over the pinned H1/H2 image, and in-place caller differential before runtime.
acceptance: Independently verify branch relocations, exact window boundaries, outside-window preservation, IPS roundtrip, differential and caller result; rerun tests and report limitations.
validation_plan: Do not edit candidate, helper, patcher or runners; do not run emulator.

tasks.goal: Autonomously compare the original and H1/H2/H3 patched game using identical isolated profiles containing the user-provided save; capture H3 load result and scene/state or precise failure.
acceptance: Offline gates and review are accepted before launch.
Use only private loopback-bound Azahar and Python GDB RSP; snapshot save hashes before/after and compare original/patched checkpoints.
Record scene, slot, field/state observations, faults and unresolved limitations; never claim H3 complete without reaching a known scene.
validation_plan: Confirm profile identity and save hash, ports free, private Azahar hash, mod IPS hash, then autonomously drive title and save/load callbacks with breakpoints.

tasks.goal: Independently review the paired H3 runtime happy-path evidence, screenshots, fixture integrity, semantic comparison, and stated limitations before promotion.
acceptance: Independently check checkpoint progression, normalized differences, screenshot scene, save/profile hashes, and whether the milestone report overclaims; report counterexamples and limits.
validation_plan: Read the pinned reports and screenshots only; do not edit candidate, runner, board, or milestone, and do not launch the emulator.

tasks.goal: Independently review H3 empty-slot, cancel, malformed-payload and unsuccessful read-error injection evidence; confirm fixture restoration and that reports keep actual read-error handling unresolved.
acceptance: Independently verify empty-slot rejection and cancellation checkpoints, compare original/patched edge outcomes, check malformed-payload and injection limits, and confirm source/staged save integrity without implying a real read-error pass.
validation_plan: Read the pinned reports and screenshots only; do not edit the runner, candidate, board, or milestone and do not launch the emulator.

tasks.goal: Independently determine whether the H3 missing-file runtime probes show a real read-failure result at the original process boundary, using the observed result bytes, process-step branch, and paired controls; identify any remaining ambiguity without overclaiming UI behavior.
acceptance: Check the status byte captured at the setter against both terminal branches in 0x002EF9AC, and compare happy-path, missing-file-before-confirm, missing-file-at-process-start, and short-file controls. State separately whether the game took a failure result branch and whether it displayed an explicit UI error. Do not launch the emulator or edit shared code/docs.
validation_plan: Independently decode the pinned original branch and recompute per-run status bytes from raw event JSON; verify save/hash restoration and report contradictions.

tasks.goal: Independently review the paired H3 trace that truncates only the disposable staged save after file open and captures the original AsdSave_Read return; calibrate against an intact-save run and verify outcome and integrity claims.
acceptance: Recompute all declared input hashes and verify both traces show successful open, requested length 0x24E30, and differing AsdSave_Read return values (intact=1, truncated=0).
Decode the observed status/result bytes against original state-6/state-7 writes; verify the error probe does not reach field manager or acknowledge success, and that no visible UI error is claimed.
Verify the disposable staged saves were restored byte-for-byte and the user source save was not an input to mutation. Record raw paired differences and limits.
validation_plan: Read and hash the frozen JSON, runner, and source; do not launch Azahar, edit shared code, update the board, or change milestones.

tasks.goal: Independently review the final H2+H3 composed image, offline caller/regression evidence, known-save runtime route, and the paired true post-open read-error traces. Reconcile claims with source and report limits.
acceptance: Recompute manifest hashes and verify image composition, IPS roundtrip, caller composition and all 12 H2 regression checkpoints.
Verify final known-save route reaches success acknowledgement and field manager in both profiles with 250 equivalent field callbacks, without overclaiming full game equivalence.

Verify post-open read failure shows open r0=1, requested size 0x24E30, AsdSave_Read r0=0 in both and intact control r0=1; describe validator r0=1 and register r0=6, but do not claim final error state, acknowledgement, visible UI or field entry.
Cross-check source and reports, record any divergence, remaining limits and recommendation for H3 closure; do not modify production code or launch emulator.
validation_plan: Hash frozen packet; independently inspect source/runtime traces and existing review; no emulator; write only assigned review document.
